commentary.text: 90+6' Dario Herrera is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+5' Dodi Lukebakio (Belgium) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Iran will have a goal kick.

90+4' Fine play by Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Belgium) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Iran will have a goal kick.

90+3' Brandon Mechele (Belgium) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Iran.
90+2' Leandro Trossard (Belgium) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Dodi Lukebakio (Belgium) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Iran will have a goal kick.

87' Shahriyar Moghanlou (Iran) is adjudged offside.

86' Alireza Beiranvand was forced into action to thwart Maxim De Cuyper (Belgium). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
85' Here is a change. Saeid Ezatolahi is going off and Amir Ghalenoei gives the last tactical orders to Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh (Iran).

15' Iran force their opponents to concede a corner.

13' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
